positions.name: RollbackRehearsalCadenceDecision
positions.frame: what makes an Atlas rollback capability real, and who is accountable for sustaining it through a recurring cadence?
positions.why: src-1 issues the standing directive fixing a monthly cadence; src-3 and src-4 restate that decision as settled scaffolding (cadence label, owner label) in the same flat, ratifying register. src-2 supplies the justifying principle — an aphoristic equivalence between rehearsal and actual possession of the capability — read at a different conviction grade (principle vs. decision) and via rational-persuasion rather than legitimate-authority power, but it is the premise the directive and its scaffolding depend on, so the group holds together as one decision-with-its-warrant even though the four expressions don't all perform the same kind of speech act.
